title: Reusable plans and case definitions
situations: A user wants the same acceptance checks on many changes.
One change needs a one-off case.
A saved plan is edited after an item has already started.
current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Plan, attachment and snapshot documentation was inspected; detailed materialize/rematerialize behavior needs implementation-specific reconciliation before publication.
Verify current docs agree on newly added cases, frozen admitted copies and plan currency; do not infer mutation semantics from a simplified diagram.
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.
